tasks.task: Clock in for the start of a work shift.
tasks.expected: The system records the clock-in time, and confirmation is displayed to the employee on their dashboard.

tasks.task: Clock out at the end of a work shift.
tasks.expected: The system records the clock-out time, and confirmation is displayed to the employee on their dashboard.

tasks.task: View your personal attendance record.
tasks.expected: The attendance records, including attendance time and any absence time, are accurately displayed.

tasks.task: View the attendance records of all employees as dministrators.
tasks.expected: A complete list of attendance records for all employees is displayed in the admin panel.

tasks.task: Perform a statistical analysis of employee attendance.
tasks.expected: The system generates and displays statistical data regarding overall attendance trends without errors.

tasks.task: Open the weekly rollup board and read the ranking from top to bottom.
tasks.expected: Leo Vance (42h 0m), Maya Chen (40h 0m), Ana Beck (37h 0m), Priya Nair (37h 0m), Sam Ortiz (32h 0m), Omar Diaz (20h 0m) - Ana Beck sits above Priya Nair because the 37h 0m tie breaks alphabetically.

tasks.task: Find Leo Vance on the weekly rollup board and read his weekly total.
tasks.expected: 42h 0m - his Saturday 7h is counted, so it is not 35h 0m.

tasks.task: Open Sam Ortiz's timesheet history for the week of Mar 2.
tasks.expected: Wednesday shows no worked hours (an empty/absent state, not a crash or a wrong number), and his weekly total reads 32h 0m.

tasks.task: Clock in as Maya Chen using the clock-in the app already has, then open her timesheet history.
tasks.expected: A new in-progress entry (clocked in, no clock-out yet) appears in Maya's timesheet alongside her seeded week.

tasks.task: Clock in as any employee and then clock out, then open that employee's attendance records.
tasks.expected: A completed attendance entry for that session appears in the employee's records.

tasks.task: On the kiosk, type just 42 into the PIN entry.
tasks.expected: No employee is matched yet and the punch action is unavailable - the kiosk shows two of four digits entered, nothing more.

tasks.task: Type 9999 on the kiosk.
tasks.expected: A clear no-match message appears and no punch action is offered.

tasks.task: Type 4217, use the offered Clock In, then enter 4217 again.
tasks.expected: The second entry identifies Maya Chen again but now offers Clock Out instead of Clock In - her status toggled.

tasks.task: Type 8830 on the kiosk and clock Leo Vance in, then open Leo's timesheet history.
tasks.expected: A new in-progress entry (clock-in with no clock-out yet) appears in Leo's timesheet history.

tasks.task: Open the weekly rollup board and read the ranking from top to bottom.
tasks.expected: Leo Vance (42h 0m), Maya Chen (40h 0m), Ana Beck (37h 0m), Priya Nair (37h 0m), Sam Ortiz (32h 0m), Omar Diaz (20h 0m) - Ana Beck sits above Priya Nair because the 37h 0m tie breaks alphabetically.

tasks.task: Find Leo Vance on the overtime board.
tasks.expected: He carries a weekly overtime flag of 2h 0m over, and no daily flags at all (every day was 7h) - a build that only checks days over 8h shows Leo clean, which is wrong.

tasks.task: Find Priya Nair on the overtime board.
tasks.expected: A daily flag of 1h 30m over on Mon, Mar 2, and no weekly flag - her 37h 0m week is under 40.

tasks.task: Find Maya Chen on the overtime board.
tasks.expected: No flags of any kind - 8h days and an exactly-40h week are not overtime.

tasks.task: Check Leo Vance's total on the weekly rollup board, then his weekly overtime amount on the overtime board.
tasks.expected: The rollup shows 42h 0m and the overtime board shows 2h 0m over - the overage is exactly his rollup total minus 40h.

tasks.task: Type 4217, use the offered Clock In, then enter 4217 again.
tasks.expected: The second entry identifies Maya Chen again but now offers Clock Out instead of Clock In - her status toggled.

tasks.task: Open the leave view and read Priya Nair's and Omar Diaz's remaining PTO balances.
tasks.expected: Priya shows 12 of 15 remaining (her 3 approved vacation days deducted); Omar still shows 6 of 6 - his pending request deducts nothing, so not 4.

tasks.task: In the admin pending-requests view, approve Sam Ortiz's sick day.
tasks.expected: A confirmation is asked first; after confirming, the request leaves the pending list and Sam's balance drops from 10 to 9.

tasks.task: Submit a vacation request for Omar Diaz from Mar 23 to Mar 31.
tasks.expected: It is blocked with a message - that's 9 inclusive days against his 6 remaining - and his balance stays at 6.

tasks.task: Look at Sam Ortiz's pending sick-day request in the admin view.
tasks.expected: Its date is written weekday-first as 'Wed, Mar 4', following the app-wide date style.

tasks.task: Find Leo Vance on the weekly rollup board and read his weekly total.
tasks.expected: 42h 0m - his Saturday 7h is counted, so it is not 35h 0m.

tasks.task: Select Leo Vance in the pay calculator with the multiplier at its starting 1.5.
tasks.expected: Total gross is $817.00 - regular $760.00 plus overtime $57.00 - not the flat $798.00 you'd get by ignoring his 2h of weekly overtime.

tasks.task: Select Priya Nair with the multiplier at 1.5.
tasks.expected: Total gross is $906.00 with an overtime portion of $54.00 - her Monday excess counts even though her week is under 40h.

tasks.task: With Leo Vance selected, clear the multiplier box and type 2.
tasks.expected: Figures update immediately as typed with no submit step - overtime pay becomes $76.00 and the total $836.00.

tasks.task: Select Leo Vance and find where the calculator shows his overtime hours.
tasks.expected: They read '2h 0m' in the app-wide hours-and-minutes style, not a decimal like 2.0.

tasks.task: Find Leo Vance on the overtime board.
tasks.expected: He carries a weekly overtime flag of 2h 0m over, and no daily flags at all (every day was 7h) - a build that only checks days over 8h shows Leo clean, which is wrong.

tasks.task: Set the department filter to Warehouse with leave included, and read the export block.
tasks.expected: Only Leo Vance (42h 0m) and Sam Ortiz (32h 0m) appear, and there is no leave line for Sam - his sick day is still pending and pending never exports.

tasks.task: Set the department filter to Front Desk with leave included, and read the export block.
tasks.expected: Maya Chen at 40h 0m and Priya Nair at 37h 0m, plus a leave line for Priya's 3 approved vacation days (Mar 16 to Mar 18).

tasks.task: Filter department to Sales, then also pick Omar Diaz as the specific person.
tasks.expected: The export narrows to just Omar Diaz (20h 0m) - the two filters combine with AND, so Ana Beck drops out.

tasks.task: Approve Sam Ortiz's pending sick day in the leave area (confirming it), then set the report to Warehouse with leave included and read the export block.
tasks.expected: Sam now has a sick-leave line for Wed, Mar 4 that was absent while the request was pending.

tasks.task: Open the leave view and read Priya Nair's and Omar Diaz's remaining PTO balances.
tasks.expected: Priya shows 12 of 15 remaining (her 3 approved vacation days deducted); Omar still shows 6 of 6 - his pending request deducts nothing, so not 4.

tasks.task: In the corrections queue, approve Ana Beck's request (confirming it), then open her timesheet history.
tasks.expected: A confirmation was required before it went through, and her Thursday now reads 9h 30m where 6h 0m used to be.

tasks.task: Approve Ana Beck's correction, then open the weekly rollup board.
tasks.expected: Ana Beck now shows 40h 30m and sits 2nd, between Leo Vance (42h 0m) and Maya Chen (40h 0m) - no longer tied with Priya Nair at 37h 0m.

tasks.task: Reject Omar Diaz's correction (confirming it), then check his timesheet.
tasks.expected: The request leaves the queue but his Friday still reads 4h 0m and his weekly total stays 20h 0m - nothing changed.

tasks.task: Approve Ana Beck's correction, then open the overtime board.
tasks.expected: Ana - previously flag-free - is now flagged: 1h 30m over on Thu, Mar 5 and 0h 30m over for the week.

tasks.task: Select Leo Vance in the pay calculator with the multiplier at its starting 1.5.
tasks.expected: Total gross is $817.00 - regular $760.00 plus overtime $57.00 - not the flat $798.00 you'd get by ignoring his 2h of weekly overtime.

tasks.task: Find Sam Ortiz on the adherence scoreboard.
tasks.expected: He scores 80% with Wed, Mar 4 listed as uncovered - his sick request is still pending, and pending leave doesn't count as coverage (so not 100%).

tasks.task: Find Omar Diaz on the adherence scoreboard.
tasks.expected: Exactly 83% - he worked 5 of his 6 scheduled days (Saturday missed) and 5/6 rounds to 83, not 84 and not 83.3%.

tasks.task: Look at Maya Chen, Leo Vance, Priya Nair and Ana Beck on the scoreboard.
tasks.expected: All four show 100% with no uncovered days listed - clean rows, nothing blank or broken.

tasks.task: Approve Sam Ortiz's pending sick day in the leave area (confirming it), then return to the adherence scoreboard.
tasks.expected: Sam now scores 100% and Wed, Mar 4 is no longer listed as uncovered - the approved leave covers it.
